description: Requires API key. Orders publication of an article about my site on a host from satelo_find_hosts (or the best match if host is omitted). The agent writes the article: original, useful to the host's readers, 1,500+ characters, 1–2 natural links to my site. Markup: blank line = paragraph, "## " = subheading, "- " = list, [text](https://url) = link. Spends the host's price + 10% Satelo fee in satellites; refunded automatically if not published.

host.description: Host domain from satelo_find_hosts (optional: best match)

link.description: URL on my site to link to

name: satelo_place_article
title: Place an article about my site
